Name: Abigail Marriage Dialogue Expanded
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
[color=#b45f06][size=6][font=Times New Roman][b]Abigail Marriage Dialogue Expanded[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]Abigail Marriage Dialogue Expanded[/b] gives your married life with Abigail a much deeper and more varied set of conversations.
Vanilla Abigail has a relatively small collection of post-marriage dialogue that can repeat frequently. This mod expands her conversations across the in-game calendar, giving you [b]1200+ new dialogue moments[/b] designed to make Abigail feel more expressive, spontaneous, and present throughout your life together.
Instead of seeing the same lines repeatedly, Abigail can have different conversations depending on the [b]day, time, season, weather, and other situations[/b].
The dialogue is designed around Abigail's personality and keeps the style of her existing Stardew Valley conversations, including her adventurous attitude, humor, curiosity, affection, and occasional weirdness.
The mod is focused entirely on [b]post-marriage dialogue[/b]. It does not change Abigail's appearance, schedule, friendship mechanics, gifts, or gameplay behavior.
[heading]✨ Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]💜 [b]1200+ new Abigail dialogue moments[/b] [/*]
[*]📅 Dialogue written for individual in-game days [/*]
[*]⏰ New conversation opportunities throughout the day [/*]
[*]🌱 Seasonal dialogue for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter [/*]
[*]🌧️ Weather-aware conversations [/*]
[*]🎉 Special dialogue for specific dates and events [/*]
[*]💬 Multiple dialogue variations for many time slots [/*]
[*]🎲 More variety to reduce repetitive conversations [/*]
[*]❤️ More affectionate and personal post-marriage interactions [/*]
[*]🗺️ Dialogue that reflects Abigail's adventurous personality [/*]
[*]🏠 Designed specifically for married-life conversations [/*]
[*]📝 Dialogue content is stored separately and can be edited [/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]🕐 More Conversations Throughout the Day[/heading]
Abigail's conversations are organized around multiple points in the day rather than relying only on a small collection of general marriage lines.
The expansion provides dialogue opportunities from [b]morning through late evening[/b], allowing her conversations to change as the day progresses.
A typical day can include dialogue around:
[b]6:00 AM → 8:00 AM → 10:00 AM → 12:00 PM → 2:00 PM → 4:00 PM → 6:00 PM → 8:00 PM → 10:00 PM[/b]
This makes conversations feel less repetitive and gives the marriage more of a daily rhythm.
[heading]📅 Full Calendar Dialogue[/heading]
The dialogue system is organized around the complete Stardew Valley calendar.
Dialogue can be written specifically for:
[list]
[*]Spring 1–28 [/*]
[*]Summer 1–28 [/*]
[*]Fall 1–28 [/*]
[*]Winter 1–28 [/*]
[/list]This allows Abigail to react to what is happening throughout the year rather than using the same generic lines every season.
[line]
[heading]🌦️ Situational Dialogue[/heading]
The expansion also supports different circumstances so Abigail's conversations can feel more connected to the current game state.
Examples include:
[list]
[*]Rainy days [/*]
[*]Different seasons [/*]
[*]Specific calendar dates [/*]
[*]Special occasions [/*]
[*]Morning conversations [/*]
[*]Afternoon conversations [/*]
[*]Evening conversations [/*]
[*]Night-time conversations [/*]
[/list]The provided Abigail dialogue reference already uses categories such as rainy-day, indoor, outdoor, seasonal, and specific-date dialogue, which this expansion builds upon rather than replacing. 
[line]
[heading]💬 More Natural Conversations[/heading]
The goal is not simply to add more text.
The dialogue is written to make Abigail feel like she is [b]actually living alongside you[/b].
Her conversations can touch on:
[list]
[*]The farm [/*]
[*]Exploring [/*]
[*]The mines [/*]
[*]Food [/*]
[*]Weather [/*]
[*]Family [/*]
[*]Memories [/*]
[*]Adventure [/*]
[*]Everyday married life [/*]
[*]Her interests [/*]
[*]Your shared life together [/*]
[/list]The result is a spouse who has something new to say more often instead of repeatedly cycling through the same few marriage lines.
[line]
[heading]📝 Editable Dialogue[/heading]
The dialogue content is stored in an external [b]JSON file[/b], making it easy for players and other creators to customize the mod.
You can edit the dialogue yourself to:
[list]
[*]Change existing lines [/*]
[*]Add new lines [/*]
[*]Remove lines [/*]
[*]Create your own variations [/*]
[*]Personalize Abigail's conversations[/*]
[/list]Move to: [color=#ffd966][size=4][font=Times New Roman]Stardew Valley\Mods\MarriageDialogueExpansion\content[/font]  [/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=3]Then move to Abigail.json and then search for the time and event wanted to change and add your own dialogues. [/size][/color]
You do not need to modify the source code just to change dialogue.
This also makes the project suitable as a foundation for future dialogue packs and community-created expansions.
[line]
[heading]💜 What This Mod Changes[/heading]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Abigail's post-marriage dialogue variety [/*]
[*]Frequency and variety of available spouse conversations [/*]
[*]Day/time-specific conversations [/*]
[*]Seasonal and situational dialogue[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]📥 Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b]. [/*]
[*]Download [b]Abigail Marriage Dialogue Expanded[/b]. [/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder. [/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI. [/*]
[*]Load your married save with Abigail. [/*]
[*]Talk to Abigail throughout the day to experience the expanded conversations. [/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]⚙️ Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/b] [/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.5.1 or later[/b] [/*]
[/list]No additional frameworks are required unless specifically listed by the current release.
[line]
[heading]⚠️ Important[/heading]
This mod is intended for [b]post-marriage Abigail gameplay[/b].
The dialogue expansion is designed to work alongside Stardew Valley's existing marriage dialogue rather than replacing Abigail's entire character or marriage system.
Because the mod contains a large amount of dialogue, some conversations are intended for particular days, times, seasons, or situations. Seeing different dialogue will depend on when and where you interact with Abigail.
